summary: Anda and Lucy, two players in a fictional online game, learn from a Clan member that executives earn real money doing missions, and accept a mission to kill some men at a cottage far across the gameworld of Dandelionwine. On the way they are ambushed twice by brigands, whom they defeat with Lucy's bow and Anda's sword, and they find the cottage guarded by sentries who raise a warning spell. The excerpt is part 31 of Book 4 and is a fiction passage.
one_line: Anda and Lucy take a paid in-game mission to a distant cottage on Dandelionwine, fighting brigands along the way.
key_facts: Anda is a member of the Fahrenheits, and attacking a Fahrenheit was bad for one's health because they would bring a war to you.
A Clan member says all the executives in the Clan pay the rent doing missions for money, and some are rich from it.
Anda and Lucy accept a mission whose goal is to go kill some guys, not anything pervy.
The mission takes Anda and Lucy to a cottage on the far side of the largest continent on the gameworld, called Dandelionwine.
Twice on the trail the pair were ambushed by brigands, something that had hardly happened to Anda since she joined the Fahrenheits.
Lucy spotted the first group of brigands before they got into sword-range and killed four of the six with her bow.
Anda's sword, described as gigantic and fast, was out during the first ambush, and Anda won that fight.
The first group's bodies yielded some gold and a couple scrolls, which the pair considered nothing to write home about.
The second group had 20 brigands who were total noobs and fought like statues.
One brigand in the second group begged for his life, and Anda ran him through and sent him to the respawn gate.
Anda typed to Lucy that she was a Fahrenheit after Lucy called her a nasty person.
The cottage target was guarded by sentries who spotted the pair long before they got within sight of it.
The sentries sent a warning spell that traveled up from their hilltop toward the cottage like a puff of smoke.
